description: State variable filter with low pass, high pass, band pass, notch and a morph output all running at once, in stereo

params.text: Sets the frequency where the filter begins to attenuate, C4 by default in the audio range; under Right Absolute spread it governs the left channel alone
Sets how steeply the response falls away past the cutoff, in eight steps from 12dB per octave to 96dB per octave
Switches the cutoff range between audio, 16.352Hz to 16744Hz with C4 as the default, and low frequency, 0.125Hz to 128Hz with 2Hz as the default
Inverts and attenuates the cutoff CV input, -100% to 100%; at 100% that CV tracks a volt per octave
Sets how much the cutoff frequency is emphasised, 0 to 1; the filter will not self oscillate without band pass feedback
Inverts and attenuates the resonance CV input, -100% to 100%
Amplifies or attenuates the input before the filter, 0 to 10; high settings drive the tanh saturation at the outputs
Inverts and attenuates the gain CV input, -100% to 100%; that CV adds 1 to the gain per volt
Sets the difference between the left and right cutoff frequencies, -2 to 2 octaves, which at high resonance produces formant sounds
Chooses how the spread is applied: half either way, the whole amount added to the right, or the right cutoff set outright by the SPREAD knob
With the right output unpatched, chooses whether the right result is averaged into the left output or subtracted from it
Inverts and attenuates the cutoff spread CV input, -100% to 100%; at 100% that CV is a volt per octave
Feeds part of the band pass result back into the filter input, sharpening the resonance, and with enough of it the filter self oscillates at the cutoff
Inverts and attenuates the feedback CV input, -100% to 100%
Crossfades between the filter modes chosen by the morph mode button, centred between them by default
Chooses which modes the morph output crossfades between, among low, band, high pass and notch pairings and the raw input against each of those
Inverts and attenuates the morph CV input, -100% to 100%
Sets whether the gain VCA is unipolar, clamped between 0V and 10V, or bipolar, clamped between -10V and 10V so the filter can ring modulate
Switches the input between DC coupled, which preserves any offset, and AC coupled, which removes it and evens out saturation asymmetry

inputs.text: Shifts the cutoff at a volt per octave, with no attenuverter in its path
Modulates the cutoff, summed with the CUTOFF knob and scaled by its attenuverter
Modulates the resonance, summed with the RES knob and scaled by its attenuverter
Modulates the gain, summed with the GAIN knob and scaled by its attenuverter
Modulates the cutoff spread, summed with the SPREAD knob and scaled by its attenuverter, and it can drive the spread past the knob limits
Modulates the band pass feedback, summed with the FDBK knob and scaled by its attenuverter
Modulates the morph crossfade, summed with the MORPH knob and scaled by its attenuverter
The left channel into the filter, which feeds the right channel too when the right input is empty
The right channel into the filter; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both channels

outputs.text: The morph crossfade for the left channel; with the right morph output empty the right result is merged in here as well
The morph crossfade for the right channel; leaving this unpatched merges the right result into the left morph output
Frequencies above the cutoff attenuated, left channel; with the right low pass empty the right result is merged in here as well
Frequencies above the cutoff attenuated, right channel; leaving this unpatched merges the right result into the left low pass output
Frequencies below the cutoff attenuated, left channel; with the right high pass empty the right result is merged in here as well
Frequencies below the cutoff attenuated, right channel; leaving this unpatched merges the right result into the left high pass output
Frequencies above and below the cutoff attenuated, left channel; with the right band pass empty the right result is merged in here as well
Frequencies above and below the cutoff attenuated, right channel; leaving this unpatched merges the right result into the left band pass output
Frequencies at and near the cutoff attenuated, left channel; with the right notch empty the right result is merged in here as well
Frequencies at and near the cutoff attenuated, right channel; leaving this unpatched merges the right result into the left notch output

menu: Disable audio output DC block — switches off the high pass filter that strips the DC offset the filter algorithm introduces in the audio range
